styles.heading: Poster styles
styles.intro: Every poster template in one place, drawn from the library with sample data. Each card is named by its configuration, so you can ask an agent for exactly that one.

sizes.heading: Poster sizes
sizes.intro: Every size a poster can print at, drawn to scale. The large sizes print on several sheets that overlap on the wall; the red strip is where the next sheet is glued on.
sizes.lineup: All sizes side by side, to scale
sizes.printShop: A print shop (a PDF, one page per sheet)
sizes.layoutNote: The sheets show the layout of the 3 × 3 ft country poster at each size: the header, the map, the names, the table and the scripture footer. The poster drawn at each size appears in Styles as it becomes available.
sizes.anySize: Any size from the shared size table

missing.bless: The sheets, the glue strips and where the card rows go come from the shared panel geometry; the cards are shown as a layout, because the Bless wall draws its cards in its own plugin.
missing.mapPrint: This template prints the live map the reader is looking at, so it has no sample picture.
missing.noCountryAtSize: No country prints at this size today: India, the one country that did, now prints at 5 × 8 ft only. It is drawn here with a sample country to show the template.

details.fileSizeUnknown: Measured when the poster is drawn
details.legacy: Legacy size: it still prints, but the print picker no longer offers it.
details.forAgents: To use this template, tell an agent: use configuration {name}.

fromPlugin: Made by its own plugin. Show full details shows it live.
